stem: One of the main goals of the Puppy Bowl is to —

options.label: A
options.text: promote finding new homes for different kinds of pets

options.label: B
options.text: encourage the public to spend more time watching real football

options.label: C
options.text: encourage viewers to play games with their own pets

options.label: D
options.text: show that puppies can do many of the same things humans do
